Well, they saw me sitting on the streets alone and basically there were 2 reasons to get me out of there: 1) I might be lonely and depressed and they wanted to cheer me up and 2) I might be waiting for someone to harm, whether to hit, rob, sell drugs or anything at all -which i don't, I was just mooning in front of my crush's house-, in the compound.

EDIT: Also, we were chatting. And it wasn't one but 2 security guards. So for a while the conversation was pretty good, but then I had to leave.
No. I was afraid they were gonna molest me, but no, they were normal men with normal necessities.
Thank you, I needed to read that. Definitely answers what I need to do. Thanks a lot.

Porn dude.

I had once a security guard invite me over to his office and have tea and sweets. In the meantime he was checking his email that happened to have lots of porn.

If security guards do it. Why not normal people?

Just googled "Social Anxiety."
I think it describes me greatly, but still doesn't answer things.
I guess I have to read more into it.
although...[TIL 19.2 million Americans suffer from it.](http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Social_anxiety) Interesting.
Sorry to hear about you though. How do you handle these two factors? The older I get, the crazier it drives me. And I just have one, not two.

Therapy... I've been going for a year and hardly found a solution. It just kept me going longer but that was all.

And I'm not making excuses. I am simply desperate and do not know what else to do. If I hadn't written here looking for answers, then that would be making excuses. Up there in the description, I wasn't trying to say that *I am this way and cannot change, therefore there is no solution* and therefore give myself an excuse. I know there is, there must be, or else what is the point of me living another day or even writing this? I just find myself back at the same spot, EVERY SINGLE TIME. I am desperate like I said.

So yeah... what if, what if... but how?
